meta.title: Battleship — outegro
meta.description: Classic Battleship online: bots of four levels, rated quick matches and private rooms with friends.

home.title: Sink the fleet.
home.lead: Classic 10×10 Battleship. Take on four bots, get matched by rating, or invite a friend with a private link.
home.guestLead: Place ten ships, then trade shots. Bots from easy to expert, rated quick matches and private rooms. One outegro account for every app.
home.rulesLead: Ten ships, straight lines, never touching — not even at the corners.
home.rulesTurn: A hit or a sinking gives you another shot. 30 seconds per turn online.
home.demoLabel: Example battle: a fleet under fire

bot.lead: Practice against four strategies. No rating at stake.

quick.lead: A human opponent near your rating. The search widens over time.

room.lead: Invite a friend with a link. Rating does not change.

upsell.body: Battleship Premium adds the two strongest bots, extended stats with a shot heatmap, match replays, every skin while it lasts and a badge on the leaderboard.
upsell.serverSaid: The game server asked for Premium. If you have just subscribed, it can take a moment to arrive.

shop.lead: Purchases never change a match. Premium unlocks the strongest bots and deep stats; the Silver Fleet is yours forever.
